description: Real frames from the owner's rig on 2026-09-14/15 (UTC): GSO 10in f/4, ASI1600MM-Cool (3.8 um), ZWO EAF, PHD2. Each FITS here is a 1024x1024 crop copied pixel-for-pixel (no resampling) from the center of the original 4656x3520 frame, so every star keeps its PSF, flux and noise; NSCROPX0/NSCROPY0 in each header give the crop origin. Originals: ~/.cache/sk-rig-data/2026-09-14 on the development machine.
independent_measurement: Elliptical 2D Gaussian fits (scipy curve_fit) on bright, unsaturated, isolated stars with a fitted local background; hfr is the half-flux radius of the unclipped, background-subtracted flux within 10 px of the fitted center. Medians per crop.

frames.context: Taken two minutes after the A/B landing test left the focuser at 6620 approached from below (HFR 2.94 by star crops).
Taken 26 s after autofocus finished with the direct move 6850 -> 6620 (downward). With 105 steps of backlash that leaves the optics where 6725 is when approached from below.

independent.note: only 2 stars passed the fit's isolation and SNR cuts in this crop; the full frame gives FWHM 7.42 px, HFR 3.82 px over 30 stars
